notes:
Summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (in-app product assistant + support chat + doc search). Ran Hosted API 14-day trial to validate UX and token cost. Primary asks now: Dedicated sizing for steady-state production, committed throughput pricing, and VPC/KMS options.

Trial highlights (customer telemetry):
- Avg QPS observed: 3.2 (overall), peak bursts up to 14 QPS during release notes push
- Typical concurrent in-flight requests: 6-9 (higher during business hours)
- Request token median: ~180; response token median: ~420; 70% of calls are short-turn chat (prompt+single-turn reply), 30% long retrieval+summary flows
- Daily token volume during trial: ~420k tokens/day; projected growth to 1.8M tokens/day at launch (6 weeks out)
- 95th pct latency on Hosted API during trial: 310ms (they want <250ms for chat primary flows)

Customer quotes from trial retrospective: "Love the dev ergonomics — streaming really sells the product. We need predictable latency and clearer unit economics for large scale."

POC/PO: customer wants a 6-month pilot on Dedicated with scaling to production if SLOs met. Cost sensitivity: medium-high; prefers committed discount vs pay-as-you-go.

Security: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS (key ownership), audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Stubs: fireflies ff_20250122_4532; gmail threads: gm_20250120_trial-setup; drive: /Drive/EchoHaven/Redwood-Pricing-Deck-v1.pdf; jira: RDW-3421 (trial latency investigation)
sizing_notes: Requested deliverable: two Dedicated sizing options with expected QPS/concurrency, token throughput, and cost: 1) conservative reserve for launch (sustain 12 QPS, 50 concurrent KV/cache warm), 2) plated small reserve for bursty usage (sustain 30 QPS with autoscale burst). Provide mapping to GPU types (A10G x8 or A100s x4) and expected 99th-pt latency under each profile.
qps_forecast: Baseline (month 0-1 post-launch): 10 QPS sustained, peak burst ~40 QPS during campaigns; Month 3 forecast: 22 QPS sustained, peak 80 QPS. Forecast rationale: product adoption curve + marketing push.
concurrency_forecast: Sustained concurrency target: 40 concurrent in-flight inference requests during peak; assume average request lifetime 600ms (chat streaming) => concurrency = QPS * latency margin. Plan for 3x headroom for cache misses and long-run summaries.
token_mix_estimate: Projected token mix at scale: 65% short chats (request 120-250 tokens, response 80-300 tokens), 25% medium retrieval/summaries (request 300-700, response 400-1200), 10% embeddings/rerank (short token counts). Estimated daily tokens at launch: 1.8M/day; peak campaign day: ~6.5M/day.
pricing_notes: Customer prefers: committed monthly pricing with overage tiers. Requesting 6-month pilot pricing + two-tier commit: 6-mo commit at 30% discount off hosted list for equivalent token volume, options to convert to annual reserved Dedicated contract. Need Redwood pricing deck + example cost per million tokens for chosen Dedicated config.
